fields.Text: Encapsulation: M → transport adds {{c1::H<sub>t</sub>}} → {{c1::segment}} → network adds {{c1::H<sub>n</sub>}} → {{c1::datagram}} → link adds {{c1::H<sub>l</sub>}} → {{c1::frame}}. In a frame the outermost header is {{c1::H<sub>l</sub>}}.

fields.Front: Match the layer to its slide description: "process-process data transfer", "routing of datagrams from source to destination", "data transfer between neighboring network elements", "bits on the wire".
Which layer does each belong to: PPP, IMAP, UDP, routing protocols, 802.11?

fields.Text: Layering (air-travel analogy): each layer implements a service via its {{c1::own internal-layer actions}}, relying on services provided by the {{c1::layer below}}. Modularization means a change in one layer's service implementation is {{c1::transparent to the rest of the system}}.
